title: ShoppingListsView: core list structure
description: Add `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/ShoppingListsView.swift` with the core list-of-lists view: `NavigationStack` with navigation title "Shopping Lists", a `List` of `ShoppingListCardView` rows driven by `ShoppingListFiles.discover` sorted reverse-chronologically, `NavigationLink` / `.navigationDestination` wiring to `ShoppingListDetailView`, and the empty state (SF Symbol `cart`, "No shopping lists yet.", "Tap + to create your first shopping list."). No top-trailing toolbar icons (no folder, no ellipsis menu). FAB and search are added in the next bead.
acceptance_criteria: `.md` files in the folder render as `ShoppingListCardView` rows sorted reverse-chronologically
Tapping a row pushes `ShoppingListDetailView` via navigationDestination
Empty state renders with `cart` icon, correct title, and subtitle when no `.md` files exist
No folder icon or ellipsis toolbar item in the top-trailing area (v1 omits both)
